88forn: Quentin "Ghost" Forn came up the line in the rain with a child's drawing of a horse and nothing else. The sergeant wrote him down as Private and pointed at the mud.
Day 3: Verdel Ridge was lost. Quentin "Ghost" Forn wrote down the news without trying to explain it.
A parcel came for Quentin "Ghost" Forn that was really meant for another soldier with the same surname. Inside: three pairs of woollen mittens. He put everything back and kept only the wrapping.
At the Chalk Pits, Quentin "Ghost" Forn of the Hegemony and Albin Zgz of the Concord traded insults across the wire for an hour. By the end they were trading recipes.

A direct hit on the trench at R-F8. Quentin "Ghost" Forn was the only one they could still help, and only just. Quentin "Ghost" Forn was killed outright by a direct hit at R-F8. The men dug for an hour and found only his identity disc.

The House of Forn sent Matthias "Rabbit" Forn after Quentin "Ghost" Forn. This time the family packed two pairs of spare socks. News that the Hegemony had taken Hill 304 reached Matthias "Rabbit" Forn during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.
Matthias "Rabbit" Forn found an old shopping list inside a coat pocket. Soap, lamp oil, apples. He folded it along the original creases.
A pocket watch went along the bench so everyone could set the time. Matthias "Rabbit" Forn has no watch, but checked it anyway, just to feel included.

Fresh from training, Matthias "Rabbit" Forn still aims the way the instructor said. Today it worked: Dorian Wman, grazed. A bullet clipped Matthias "Rabbit" Forn's helmet at R-F8 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low. Shot by Yann Spring of the Concord (@spring_7398).
Stitches out, sleeve rolled down. Matthias "Rabbit" Forn is whole again, or near enough for the line.
Victory at Blackwater Canal. Matthias "Rabbit" Forn let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.

Casimir Shi fell asleep on watch. Matthias "Rabbit" Forn took over without waking Casimir, and told the sergeant nothing. The clerk counted the names twice. Matthias "Rabbit" Forn is number 145 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. On Day 11, Grey Mill passed to the Hegemony. Matthias "Rabbit" Forn wrote the name in his diary with unusual care.
Matthias "Rabbit" Forn and Ivo "Bones" Rylan found a cat in the ruins at Blackwater Canal and argued for an hour about its name. The cat settled it by sleeping on Bones.
Asked what he will do after the war, Matthias "Rabbit" Forn said: 'Be a schoolteacher in Oakmere. And never complain about anything, ever again.'
A parcel contained a bar of chocolate broken into uneven pieces. Matthias "Rabbit" Forn closed his eyes while someone else distributed them.
Matthias "Rabbit" Forn tried to describe the smell of Oakmere and got as far as the bakery. Then the ration cart arrived.
Matthias "Rabbit" Forn lent Casimir Shi a pencil. It came back wrapped in a scrap of paper that said 'One good turn'.
bri3kcls: "You're late," said the corporal when Quentin "Rabbit" Kcls arrived on Day 8. "Everyone's late. Get a spade."
Quentin "Rabbit" Kcls's spoon vanished during supper. He scratched a mark into a replacement and began keeping a closer eye on the washing bucket.

The Hegemony secured Blackwater Canal. Quentin "Rabbit" Kcls helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly. A letter from home reached Quentin "Rabbit" Kcls before dusk. Quentin "Rabbit" Kcls read it twice and slept a little easier. Quentin "Rabbit" Kcls reported for duty as a rifleman. The new kit was heavier than the explanation of how to use it.

The sergeant at S-S3 called out a range and a spot. Quentin "Rabbit" Kcls was the only one who hit it. Silas Kstoner was grazed. The clerk counted the names twice. Quentin "Rabbit" Kcls is number 569 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. The Hegemony took Grey Mill, and the orders at S-S3 changed before the cheering ended. Quentin "Rabbit" Kcls shouldered another load.
Shellfire stopped the carrying party at a trench junction. Quentin "Rabbit" Kcls waited under a load that got heavier by the minute.
Quentin "Rabbit" Kcls wrote a song about the Chalk Pits. Jakub Relations wrote a second verse. The squad has banned the third.
A parcel came for Quentin "Rabbit" Kcls that was really meant for another soldier with the same surname. Inside: two knitted scarves. He put everything back and kept only the wrapping.

Quentin "Rabbit" Kcls borrowed the sergeant's periscope, found a target, handed it back, and fired. Rafael "Saint" Simplepach was badly wounded. A letter from home reached Quentin "Rabbit" Kcls before dusk. Quentin "Rabbit" Kcls read it twice and slept a little easier.

Somebody across the wire was singing. Then Silas Kstoner stood up to sing louder, and Quentin "Rabbit" Kcls fired. Silas Kstoner was grazed. The singing stopped. Quentin "Rabbit" Kcls fired at a loophole in the enemy wall and heard a shout. It was Rafael Carwyn, badly wounded.
deutsches_kaiserreich_official: Rafael Official told the sergeant he was a tram conductor. The sergeant said the war needed one of those like it needed a hole in the roof, and put him on sentry.

A tin cup glinted on the enemy parapet. Rafael Official aimed just below it. Konrad Aquaboy was gravely wounded. Day 10. Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony. Rafael Official watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.

Rafael Official lay in the ruins of Blackwater Canal from dawn to dusk. He did not fire once. That is also a kind of victory. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Rafael Official answered to number 894. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Rafael Official kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.
A periscope poked up from the enemy line. Rafael Official shot it to pieces, and the man holding it, Wendel Jhomey, was grazed.
A dummy head on a stick drew the enemy's eye at R-R13. Rafael Official saw where the answering shot came from and fired back. Viktor Newnario was gravely wounded.
A parcel from home held a comb. Rafael Official has hardly any hair left after the last haircut, but he appreciated the thought.
Rafael Official fired at the enemy dawn watch from R-R13. Jakub Virajvirxgil was grazed, and the enemy line spent the morning with its heads down.
Rafael Official had been watching the same gap for an hour. When Jakub Virajvirxgil crossed it, Rafael Official fired. Jakub Virajvirxgil was badly wounded.
dfeeney.03: Leopold "Rabbit" Dfeeney arrived with the Day 11 draft, carrying a child's drawing of a horse and the news from home, which was old by the time he told it.
Leopold "Rabbit" Dfeeney wrote a song about the Hanging Bridge. Norbert Kolor wrote a second verse. The squad has banned the third.
Quentin Caden of the Concord shouted a joke across the wire at Verdel Ridge. Leopold "Rabbit" Dfeeney of the Hegemony laughed before remembering not to. Both lines heard it.
Leopold "Rabbit" Dfeeney got a photo of the family house. He spent longer looking at the strange curtains than at the faces.

Leopold "Rabbit" Dfeeney was hit in the forearm at U-F2. Clean through the meat, the medic said. He asked if that was good. The medic said it was the best kind. Shot by Arno "Rabbit" Snake of the Concord (@__snake__cx).
Leopold "Rabbit" Dfeeney no longer winces when he lifts his rifle. The medic signed him off with a grunt.
eli_is_a_goat: Felix "Mud" Goat arrived on Day 11 as a replacement. The men in U-F3 had been fighting for 11 days already and looked at his clean boots like a rumour from another world. Felix "Mud" Goat walked the captured trenches of Grey Mill and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.

Felix "Mud" Goat was hit in the forearm at U-F3. Clean through the meat, the medic said. He asked if that was good. The medic said it was the best kind. Shot by Roland "Button" Lahetta of the Concord (@cody_lahetta).
The medic cut the last bandage off Felix "Mud" Goat's arm and threw it in the stove. He went back to U-F3 the same hour.
A flare lit Lantern Hill like noon. Felix "Mud" Goat counted the seconds until darkness: eleven.

At U-F3 the men had a bet on who would hit something first. Felix "Mud" Goat won the bet. Jakub Asdf was grazed. A bullet clipped Felix "Mud" Goat's helmet at U-F3 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low. Shot by Benedikt "Lucky" Lachlan of the Concord (@lachlan_0706).
Felix "Mud" Goat came back to the squad today. The men had kept his spot on the fire step and his spoon.
filip_ogwanga: Rafael "Saint" Ogwanga came from Ashford Vale, where there is a river, a church and no mud at all. He talks about all three as if they were people.
Rafael "Saint" Ogwanga held the mirror while Ulrich Asher shaved. The arrangement survived the shaving but not the comments.
The order named Rafael "Saint" Ogwanga as Lance Corporal. He read it twice, then asked who would take over his watch.

Rafael "Saint" Ogwanga found a blank menu card and wrote the evening ration on it in elaborate handwriting. The bread became 'Bread, in the Army Manner'. Rafael "Saint" Ogwanga walked the captured trenches of Hill 304 and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.
Rafael "Saint" Ogwanga had been watching the same gap for an hour. When Leopold "Brick" Moovin crossed it, Rafael "Saint" Ogwanga fired. Leopold "Brick" Moovin was grazed.
Rafael "Saint" Ogwanga's menu now circulates before supper. Someone has requested a wine list. The water bucket has been given a vintage.
Oskar Urfavv of the Concord shouted a joke across the wire at the Chalk Pits. Rafael "Saint" Ogwanga of the Hegemony laughed before remembering not to. Both lines heard it.
Rafael "Saint" Ogwanga saved half a biscuit for later. Later came six minutes afterwards.

Rafael "Saint" Ogwanga made it into the enemy trench and out again, but a machine gun swept no man's land on the way home. Rafael "Saint" Ogwanga crawled the last yards. Word came down the line: Blackwater Canal is ours. Rafael "Saint" Ogwanga shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.

Rafael "Saint" Ogwanga's bandage came off today. The scar is ugly. He is rather proud of it. The clerk counted the names twice. Rafael "Saint" Ogwanga is number 225 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Grey Mill. Rafael "Saint" Ogwanga folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.
A bullet clipped Rafael "Saint" Ogwanga's helmet at S-F18 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low. Shot by Florian Monkey of the Concord (@autistic_monkey3).
Back on the fire step at S-F18. Rafael "Saint" Ogwanga says the wound itches, which the medics say is a good sign.
Rafael "Saint" Ogwanga spent the night in no man's land with pliers and a roll of wire. Every flare meant lying flat in the mud. The gap at S-F18 is closed now.
Rafael "Saint" Ogwanga reached up to fix a sandbag at S-F18 and a bullet took the skin off two knuckles. The sandbag got fixed anyway. Shot by Bastian "Ghost" Kgss of the Concord (@kg1912ss).
The medic cut the last bandage off Rafael "Saint" Ogwanga's arm and threw it in the stove. He went back to S-F18 the same hour.
hiro.ki353: Felix "Ghost" Hiro arrived on Day 9 and found the section asleep. The welcome had to wait until somebody needed the kettle.
The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Blackwater Canal. Felix "Ghost" Hiro read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.

Felix "Ghost" Hiro buried two men at the edge of Hill 304 and said the words twice, because the shells interrupted the first time. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Felix "Ghost" Hiro is number 740. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. The Hegemony won Grey Mill. In S-C5, Felix "Ghost" Hiro listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.
Felix "Ghost" Hiro held a service in a shell hole. Eleven men came. Two of them had never prayed before. Both of them asked for another.
Felix "Ghost" Hiro wrote letters for men who could not write, and some for men who could but did not know the words.
Felix "Ghost" Hiro held a service beside a ration store. The men sang quietly so the sleepers behind the wall could rest.
Felix "Ghost" Hiro tried to dry a page near the stove. The paper survived, but the message now has the smell of toasted bread.
Matthias Gasmask and Felix "Ghost" Hiro divided a parcel using a tin lid as scales. The last crumb needed a second opinion.
jacobflamberg: Nils Jacobflamber left a sweetheart who has stopped writing behind in Esterhaus and came up the line with a child's drawing of a horse. The men noticed at once that he hums hymns when frightened.
The Hegemony won Blackwater Canal. In S-R9, Nils Jacobflamber listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.

In reserve, Nils Jacobflamber slept nine hours in a barn. He dreamt of nothing, which was the best part. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Nils Jacobflamber answered to number 794. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Nils Jacobflamber kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.
A borrowed towel came back cleaner than when Nils Jacobflamber lent it. He is considering lending out the rest of the washing.
A supply man offered Nils Jacobflamber a damaged gramophone in exchange for help unloading. He accepted before asking whether there were any records.
Nils Jacobflamber coaxed the gramophone into turning. It plays a waltz with a scratched introduction, but something knocks once every revolution.
Nils Jacobflamber woke up at the usual time for night watch, even in the rear. It took several minutes to convince him to go back to sleep.

A bullet went into Nils Jacobflamber's chest just under the heart at S-R9. The medic said not to give him water, and then said nothing more. Shot by Hugo Klecka of the Hegemony (@klecka2617). The bearers reached Nils Jacobflamber at S-R9 too late. One shot, and it was over. Shot by Hugo Klecka of the Hegemony (@klecka2617).
Gustav Jacobflamber had heard about Nils Jacobflamber's courage. At S-R9, he also heard about the snoring, the cards and the terrible handwriting.
notbrayden.mp4: Severin "Mud" Notbrayden unpacked a bullet that missed him at N-F7. The man in the next bunk shifted his bag to make room without asking what it was. The sergeant read out the order: Grey Mill has fallen, hold the line. Severin "Mud" Notbrayden looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.
Severin "Mud" Notbrayden spent the night filling sandbags. By dawn he could no longer close his hands. By noon the shells had emptied half of them again.
Shrapnel at the Brickworks. Severin "Mud" Notbrayden walked to the medics on his own feet and asked for a cigarette before the stitches.
Severin "Mud" Notbrayden came back to the squad today. The men had kept his spot on the fire step and his spoon.

Severin "Mud" Notbrayden was hit in the forearm at N-F7. Clean through the meat, the medic said. He asked if that was good. The medic said it was the best kind. Shot by Florian Human of the Hegemony (@ordinary_human51).
Severin "Mud" Notbrayden's wound has closed. He showed the scar to everyone at N-F7 until the sergeant told him to put his shirt back on.
raso_ronnie: Emil Ronnie arrived with the Day 16 draft, carrying a dented harmonica and the news from home, which was old by the time he told it.
the_eclecticnerd: Florian Eclecticnerd came up on Day 11 carrying news from Dunmarrow. A man interrupted to ask whether the railway clock had been repaired. Day 11. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. From the heights Florian Eclecticnerd could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable. The new duty roster listed Florian Eclecticnerd as a stretcher bearer. He kept checking the old roster until someone took it down.

A patient apologized for bleeding on Florian Eclecticnerd's sleeve. He told the patient to concentrate on staying awake. A letter from home reached Florian Eclecticnerd before dusk. Florian Eclecticnerd read it twice and slept a little easier.
Florian Eclecticnerd splinted a broken leg with a rifle and two belts. The patient asked if he was a real doctor. He said yes. He was lying.

Wiring party. Florian Eclecticnerd held the coil while two others pulled. Twenty yards of new wire at U-F19, and everyone came back. A letter from home reached Florian Eclecticnerd before dusk. Florian Eclecticnerd read it twice and slept a little easier.

A bullet hit Florian Eclecticnerd's belt buckle at U-F19 and glanced off into his side. Shallow, the medic said. He is keeping the buckle. Shot by Leopold Evans of the Concord (@micheal.evans09). A letter from home reached Florian Eclecticnerd before dusk. Florian Eclecticnerd read it twice and slept a little easier.

A bullet hit Florian Eclecticnerd in the back as he turned to pass ammunition along at U-F19. He went down on the duckboards and the men shouted for the bearers. Shot by Otto "Spark" Kraljmk of the Concord (@kraljmk87). Florian Eclecticnerd was carried to the aid post and straight back out. Full. He waits on a stretcher by the door, holding a frozen apple. The letter for Florian Eclecticnerd had been in the rain somewhere along the way. Florian Eclecticnerd dried it by the stove, page by page.
tsafler: Wendel Tsafler came up with a draft of replacements on Day 9. Nobody asked his name until the third night. After that, everyone knew it.
News of the loss of Blackwater Canal reached S-C11 with the rations. Wendel Tsafler ate while listening to the revised orders.

Frost made each footprint distinct. Wendel Tsafler followed a trail to the missing ration sack and found the quartermaster sitting on it. The clerk counted the names twice. Wendel Tsafler is number 701 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Wendel Tsafler kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.
A round came through a gap in the sandbags at S-C11 and grazed Wendel Tsafler's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. Shot by Walter Small of the Hegemony (@ner_small).
Three days with a bandage, and Wendel Tsafler is back at S-C11. He says the food at the aid post was worse than the food in the trench. Nobody believes him.
Wendel Tsafler kept Severin "Shadow" Defender awake all night with questions about home: the street, the shop, the dog. By morning Wendel could have walked there blind.
Wendel Tsafler has learned to recognize the ration cart by its squeaky wheel. This afternoon, a different squeak caused real disappointment.
The sergeant at S-C11 called out a range and a spot. Wendel Tsafler was the only one who hit it. Marek Azstarlord was grazed.
vazeny_pan_soukup: Jakub Soukup came up the line with a pressed cornflower and nothing else. The sergeant wrote him down as Private and pointed at the mud.

Part of the parapet collapsed near Jakub Soukup. Repairs started as soon as the dust settled, with one man on watch while the rest worked. Jakub Soukup transferred to the snipers. The men in P-F11 said they would miss him. He is only three dugouts away. The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Grey Mill. Jakub Soukup folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.

Jakub Soukup fired once through the steel loophole at P-F11 and closed the shutter before the echo came back. Quentin Yelloowman was gravely wounded. A dummy head on a stick drew the enemy's eye at P-F11. Jakub Soukup saw where the answering shot came from and fired back. Jakub "Bones" Travel was grazed. A letter from home found Jakub Soukup before the night shift. Jakub Soukup folded it small and kept it close.
Jakub Soukup and Clement Baker carried a kettle through three narrow turns without spilling a drop. The applause at the end caused the accident.
A bullet clipped Jakub Soukup's helmet at P-F11 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low. Shot by Bram "Button" Nailonailon of the Concord (@nailonailon).

A bullet went into Jakub Soukup's chest just under the heart at P-F11. The medic said not to give him water, and then said nothing more. Shot by Lucien "Brick" Yuas of the Concord (@krauser.yuas). Jakub Soukup was killed on watch at P-F11. The men found his rifle still resting on the parapet, aimed at the spot the shot came from. Shot by Lucien "Brick" Yuas of the Concord (@krauser.yuas).
Severin "Doc" Soukup had heard about Jakub Soukup's courage. At P-F11, he also heard about the snoring, the cards and the terrible handwriting.

Severin "Doc" Soukup felt a hard tug at his hip at P-F11. The bullet had cut through his belt and the skin under it. He tied the belt back together with string. Shot by Hugo Jak of the Concord (@jak_11.7).
w1ll1am_e: Walter "Ghost" Wllame joined the replacements on Day 9. An old hand checked his pack straps before asking his name.
Day 10: Blackwater Canal was lost. Walter "Ghost" Wllame wrote down the news without trying to explain it.

A flare caught Walter "Ghost" Wllame halfway through a yawn on the fire step. He stayed still until his jaw ached. The sergeant read out the order: Grey Mill has fallen, hold the line. Walter "Ghost" Wllame looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.
Walter "Ghost" Wllame hummed an old song from home on sentry. From the other side of the wire, very faintly, someone hummed it back.

A single shot from across the wire hit Walter "Ghost" Wllame in the thigh at Q-F11. He crawled the last yards on his elbows. Shot by Pavel "Mud" Flamboyantno of the Hegemony (@flamboyantnoble). The bearers reached Walter "Ghost" Wllame at Q-F11 too late. One shot, and it was over. Shot by Pavel "Mud" Flamboyantno of the Hegemony (@flamboyantnoble).
Zeno Wllame arrived carrying the family name of Walter "Ghost" Wllame. The corporal asked how to pronounce his first name, and waited for the answer.
The listening post reported scraping beyond the wire. Zeno Wllame waited through an hour of it before a loose stake was found.
Listening post, three in the morning. Zeno Wllame heard boots, then whispering, then nothing. Just a fox, the corporal said. He did not sleep afterwards.
Zeno Wllame carried in the drummer, who lied about his age to enlist. the drummer kept asking whether his mother would be told.
